item.title: Sanderson Design revenue jumps 6% on North America and manufacturing strength
item.summary: Sanderson Design Group reported a 6% rise in first-half revenue, as strong demand in North America and a recovery in its manufacturing arm offset continued softness in its home UK market. The luxury interiors group, whose brands include Morris & Co. and Zoffany, said revenue rose to £51.4m in the six months to 31 July, […] The post Sanderson Design revenue jumps 6% on North America and manufacturing strength appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
